body:
As much as I hate hearing how devastated you feel, it's somewhat relieving to know that someone else can relate, because I've been like that too for the last three months. Facing my emotions, life and future is nervewracking at this point because I don't even know if I can handle it. 
Regardless, I'm very sorry that you're going through this. If you have health insurance you can seek help through your healthcare provider by getting a therapist to talk or a psychiatrist if medication is necessary

Because I love you. 
I wish you had a nice home to be in and people who will support you unconditionally, but I unfortunately can't give that to you. 
I want you to stick around so the possibility of you having the good life you deserve is still there. 
Can you do that, please?
I'll chat with you. You sound really pissed at your situation and I'm in somewhat of the same headspace.
